Brazilians also vote in a presidential runoff between Lula and Bolsonaro.
text.europe: Serbia votes on a grassroots challenge to Vučić's 12-year rule, with his supporters still backing him and opposition voters calling it a referendum on him. Thomas Markle Sr denies possessing child abuse images, María Corina Machado returns to Venezuela, and Brazil holds its presidential runoff.
